rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the visible, contemptuous facial sneer.

example.english: After hearing that, they curled one corner of their mouth into a sneer.
example.traditional: 佢聽完之後嘴角一翹，露出一個冷笑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 teng1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 zeoi2 gok3 jat1 kiu4 lou6 ceot1 jat1 go3 laang5 siu3

rows.jyutping: deoi3 A ge3 tai2 m4 hei2
rows.note: Use this for the contempt or scorn felt toward a person or thing, rather than the facial expression itself.

example.english: They could feel my sneer at them right away.
example.traditional: 我對佢嘅睇唔起，佢一早就感覺到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 tai2 m4 hei2 keoi5 jat1 zou2 zau6 gam2 gok3 dou3
